missionPremise: P-270's address half (map #424, LDT #721, live on PE fohg2os70 and cortex-api 00843-yir) made the address line carry the ledger's ZIP; the CITY half did not land. Measured live 2026-09-18 in `_inbox/2026-09-18_221332_surface_probe.json` and re-measured by this lane (`_inbox/2026-09-19_025436_surface_probe.json`): `X2-address` opens on 11 of 40 subjects, of which FOUR drop a licensed city from a line that exists (48453:445501 Pflugerville, 48453:157574 Briarcliff, 48453:959606 Elgin, 48453:941831 Elgin) and SEVEN serve no composed address at all (the absent-situs X6/XD-7 class). The dispatch's diagnosis, re-read at source in pe-record-to-facets.ts at b08f4b89: `composeBaseFactsSitus` licenses the city-limits city only when the RECORD-served `situsCity` cell is `absent-verified`; on these parcels the retrieval reader serves `situsCity`/`situsZip`/`situsState` as `legacy-transitional` (the wire's own `recordRailStates`, read on 48453:445501 in the artifact), so the branch never runs, while `baseFacts.situsCity` carries the same `absent-verified` verdict from the bake and the served `cityLimitsFact` names the incorporated city. The label contract was ALREADY pinned at the start commit and this lane did not invent it: `situs-address.ts` (`SitusLineParts.situsCityBasis: 'cad-roll' | 'city-limits' | null`, `SITUS_CITY_LIMITS_NOTE`, `situsCityLimitsNote()`) shipped with the address half, typed and documented, with only the fact-sheet path calling it.

It composes the same string either way; the basis changes only what may be SAID about the city.

theLicenceDecision.chosen: The payload-declaration fallback: the licence accepts the payload's OWN declared absence of the roll's situs city, whatever path served it.
theLicenceDecision.why: It is local to the composing surfaces and closes the measured defect without a ledger decision. The declaration the licence reads is the payload's own `baseFacts.situsCity` object (`verdict: 'absent-verified'`, authority the county CAD roll) and the city it may name must come from the payload's own served `cityLimitsFact`; so the licence never asserts anything the payload does not carry.
theLicenceDecision.theOtherOptionAndWhatItWouldHaveNeeded: Cutting the three situs rails (situsCity, situsZip, situsState) over to the `record` path. That is a ledger decision owned above this lane: it needs the rails slated for these parcels, a retrieval-api reader that serves them as `record` rather than `legacy-transitional`, and a population-blast-radius read before the write (P-320 is still open and two counties have been emptied by presence-shaped writes). It would also have closed the ZIP half only by luck, since the ZIP already reaches the line from the bake via `mergeBakedBaseFacts`.
theLicenceDecision.theRuleAsApplied: A city is named only when BOTH hold: (1) the payload's own situs city is a DECLARED absence with verdict `absent-verified` — a bare null, `refused`, `lookup-failed`, `not-applicable`, or a rail that never served licenses NOTHING, because the roll's silence is not evidence the roll has no city; (2) the payload's own served `cityLimitsFact` is `incorporated` AND names a city. A readable roll city is never replaced. The city named is stamped `situsCityBasis: 'city-limits'`, and every renderer must present it as 'the city whose limits contain this parcel'.
theLicenceDecision.whereItIsEnforced: map `applyCityLimitsSitusLicence` (pe-property-atoms.ts, applied after applyRecordPatch at the one point every served facets payload passes through), LDT `situsCompose.resolveSitusCity` (reached by smartSiteStub via assembleStubBody), and the probe's grader `addressCarriesLedgerLine` (doc_repo) which now READS the basis and FAILS an unlicensed city.

threeQuestionGate.whatExecutesTheLicence: map `applyCityLimitsSitusLicence` in `apps/property-explorer/api/_lib/pe-property-atoms.ts`, called on every served facets payload immediately after `applyRecordPatch`; LDT `situsCompose.resolveSitusCity`, called by `composeSmartSiteStub`; and the probe's `addressCarriesLedgerLine` for the grade.
threeQuestionGate.whatTriggersIt: A payload whose own `baseFacts.situsCity` is a DECLARED absence with verdict `absent-verified` AND whose own served `cityLimitsFact` is `incorporated` with a city name. Nothing else: no readable roll city, no bare null, no `lookup-failed`, no unincorporated or unmeasured answer.
threeQuestionGate.whatFailsWhenAnUnlicensedCityIsNamed: The probe row `X2-address` FAILS with the payload's own cityLimits answer printed beside the city it named ('the payload names \"X\" … and its own cityLimitsFact does not license it'), proved in both directions in the self-test. On the card, a city-limits city that is not stamped `situsCityBasis: 'city-limits'` loses its note (`situsCityLimitsNote` returns null for an unstated basis), which is a rendering gap rather than a silent false claim — and the probe catches the unlicensed name on the wire.
threeQuestionGate.whatBypassesIt: The PDF surface (not touched by this row: it composes its own line and is not measured by X2). LDT `projectSavedPropertyLabel` (a saved-property list label) and `firstPresentSitusLabel` (draw/inspect label) pass `composed` without components and so never compose a city from baseFacts; they merge no cityLimits answer and need no licence. Every consumer of the map's `composeSitusLine` is covered because the licence runs at the served-payload boundary, not at the composer.
